 ◢◤ interzone  matrix, deployed anywhere                                                                        ONLINE  
╭────────────────────────╮╭────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ ▸ Setup                ││                                                                                            │
│                        ││   Keys  any key closes this                                                                │
│ ▾ Manage example.org   ││                                                                                            │
│ ▌ ⌂ Overview           ││   On this screen                               C        Compress Synapse's state           │
│   @ Users              ││     ↑↓       select                            d        Server dashboard                   │
│   # Rooms              ││     enter    run                               l        View logs                          │
│   ▦ Dashboard          ││     a–z      shortcuts                         f        Fine-tune the roles                │
│   ↻ What's new         ││     u        Update the server                 $        Database shell                     │
│   ◷ Backups            ││     c        Check services                    x        Run playbook tags                  │
│   ⚑ Alerts             ││     r        Restart all services              w        Change the setup                   │
│   ↺ Restore            ││     n        What's new                        v        Move to another server             │
│   ↶ Roll back          ││     i        Check container images            o        Other servers                      │
│   ✎ Fine-tune          ││     A        Alerts                            X        Uninstall everything               │
│   ⚒ Maintenance        ││     p        Start, stop or reinstall serv…                                                │
│   ⇢ Move server        ││     U        Update interzone                Anywhere                                      │
│   ▤ Servers            ││     a        Add a user                        ctrl+k   go to a screen or action           │
│                        ││     m        Manage users                      ctrl+b   the menu                           │
│ ▸ Mirrors              ││     R        Manage rooms                      esc      back                               │
│                        ││     b        Back up the database              ?        these keys                         │
│ ▸ Test                 ││     s        Backups                           ctrl+s   save answers                       │
│                        ││     e        Restore a backup                  ctrl+l   layout: auto (wide)                │
│ ▸ Host                 ││     z        Roll back                         ctrl+y   theme: interzone                   │
│                        ││     D        Disk space                        q        quit, when not typing              │
│ ▾ Servers              ││     V        Vacuum the database               ctrl+c   quit                               │
│   ● example.org        ││     P        Upgrade Postgres                                                              │
│                        ││                                                                                            │
│                        ││                                                                                            │
│                        ││                                                                                            │
│                        ││                                                                                            │
│ ◫ auto (wide)  ctrl+l  ││                                                                                            │
│ ◐ interzone  ctrl+y    ││                                                                                            │
│ ◂ fold   ctrl+b menu   ││                                                                                            │
╰────────────────────────╯╰────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
 ↑↓ select   ·   enter run   ·   a–z shortcuts   ·   esc back   ·   ? all keys   ·   ctrl+c quit
